title: LangGraph state in 45 seconds
hook: Stop losing agent context between steps.
body: Put every field your Shorts pipeline needs into a typed WorkflowState. Nodes return partial updates; Pydantic validates the merge. That is how you stop silent key typos from breaking production agents.
cta: Clone the typed-state pattern in your next graph.
